Monthly climate normals for SHMI's Cover seasons

Source: R/climate.R
get_shmi_climate.Rd

Extracts long-term monthly mean temperature and precipitation (WorldClim 2.1, 1970-2000) at each location, in the form compute_cover() and build_shmi() expect. Requires the geodata and terra packages; the global WorldClim layers are downloaded once to path.

Usage

get_shmi_climate(locations, res = 10, path = file.path(tempdir(), "worldclim"))

Arguments

locations

Either the list returned by prepare_shmi_inputs(), whose management units supply coordinates (MGT_lat, MGT_lon) and irrigation (MGT_irr_cat), or a data frame with MGT_combo, lon and lat (decimal degrees) and optionally irrigated (logical). Irrigated units ignore the dry-month rule.

res

WorldClim resolution in arc-minutes: 10, 5 or 2.5 (finer means a larger download).

path

Folder for the downloaded WorldClim files.

Value

A tibble with MGT_combo, tavg_01 ... tavg_12 (C), prec_01 ... prec_12 (mm) and irrigated.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inputs  <- prepare_shmi_inputs(get_shmi_example())
climate <- get_shmi_climate(inputs)      # coordinates and irrigation from Mgt_Unit

# or from a table of coordinates
locs <- data.frame(MGT_combo = c("farm1_trt1", "farm1_trt2"),
                   lon = -105.08, lat = 40.59, irrigated = c(FALSE, TRUE))
climate <- get_shmi_climate(locs)
} # }
